preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, L and R must be integers where 1 <= L <= R <= 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum((x * len(str(x))) for x in range(L, R + 1)) % 1000000007)
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the goodness of all integers from L to R, modulo 1,000,000,007.
